title: Nelson, NSN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nelson, NSN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nelson is a city in NSN with a population of 55,000. New Zealand’s sunniest city, a creative hub at the top of the South Island known for its arts, craft beer, and national parks. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
